name: convenience-store-selfie
image_purpose: Instagram lifestyle selfie and spontaneous night-out post

prompt.project_info: Create an ultra-photorealistic vertical UGC convenience-store selfie for an approved adult, preserving the cooler-door reflection, ponytail, white fitted camisole, navy pleated skirt, and fluorescent night setting.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult with black hair in a long straight ponytail, curvy figure and feminine silhouette, wearing a white fitted camisole with secure coverage and a navy pleated skirt, holding a smartphone. Keep the expression playful and natural without sexualized framing.
prompt.composition_elements: Side-profile selfie captured in the reflective glass cooler door, head turned toward the reflection, relaxed slight back angle, colorful drink bottles, cooler condensation, glossy floor reflections, and empty drink aisle. Vertical 2:3 framing.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Cool white fluorescent store lighting with hard highlights, crisp natural shadows, reflective glass, and authentic late-night convenience-store atmosphere.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic iPhone 15 Pro-style capture, 24mm lens, vertical 2:3, realistic glass reflection, high detail, natural skin texture and subtle digital grain.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Ultra-photorealistic vertical 2:3 smartphone selfie of an approved adult with black hair in a long straight ponytail, wearing a white fitted camisole with secure coverage and a navy pleated skirt, captured in the reflective glass door of a convenience-store drink cooler at night. Side-profile pose, playful natural expression, colorful drink bottles, cooler condensation, glossy floor reflections, empty aisle, cool white fluorescent lighting, crisp shadows, realistic reflective glass and candid UGC atmosphere.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, voyeuristic framing, visible nipple outline, exposed intimate areas, lingerie emphasis, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, distorted reflection, extra fingers, warped phone, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, invented text, logo artifacts

assets.name: convenience-store-selfie.jpg
assets.usage: Preserve the approved adult's hair, white camisole, navy skirt, smartphone, cooler-door reflection, drink aisle, condensation, and fluorescent store environment.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, hair, outfit coverage, phone, reflection integrity, store environment, and lighting. Garments, phone, and drink products may be replaced while keeping the same composition. Preserve only supplied product labels or typography; do not invent new logos or text.

changes: Removed voyeuristic and nipple-outline wording while preserving the supplied outfit, pose, and convenience-store concept.
